status: evidence audit fixed after locating the public AS295 catalogs and reading their aggregate sample sizes; no collisionless-stress feature, lensing target, or gravity score is opened
purpose: Determine whether the public Ruel 2014 and Bayliss 2016 AS295 spectroscopy supplies an independent, deduplicated sample large enough to satisfy the already-frozen matched v17 stage-B collisionless-stress gate.

audit_rules.deduplication: Maximum-cardinality one-to-one sky matching within the fixed radius, ordered by increasing angular separation. A matched object is one spectrum, never two members.

known_before_this_file_was_written: Ruel table 4 reports N=30 for AS295.
Bayliss table 2 reports 38 spectra and 29 members for AS295.
An exploratory coordinate comparison indicated that the two object tables overlap almost completely.
decision_rule: Stage B remains prohibited unless the deduplicated AS295 sample has at least 50 secure spectroscopic members and every other frozen stage-B prerequisite is met for both spent clusters.
Do not add the Ruel and Bayliss member totals: duplicated sky positions represent the same galaxies.
Do not lower the 50-member threshold, select PLCKG287 alone, or use photometric redshifts as velocity measurements after a shortfall.
A readiness pass would authorize construction of a target-blind source proxy only; it would not validate a gravity formula or open a holdout.
